spec.model: none; native build and component smoke
spec.purpose: Build a default-off mixed selective-QK prefix and original-accumulator suffix experiment before same-DLL q8192/out512 GB10 gates: ck

Use the retained Dense1000/MoE512, expert-order and coarse OUT stack with one new CK DLL. Zero tail preserves complete original attention. A nonzero tail sends complete earlier cold query slabs through selective probability repair with an approximate denominator and retains original attention for the final queries. This is an unproved numerical experiment. Original q8192 prompt IDs, all512 GB10 outputs, first-logit tolerance0.125 and actual callbacks remain required. Failed correctness invalidates performance retention. Decode, prefix continuation and long-context dispatch are unchanged. No release qualification is inherited.
